description: Final provenance figure: Foldseek E-values per PP_0788 region, aromatic-cage benchmark, 63-genome neighbour enrichment, and the internal repeat test; plus the GO decision table
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

nb  = pd.read_csv("neighbour_enrichment_corrected.csv")
tud = pd.read_csv("tudor_comparison.csv")
rep = pd.read_csv("internal_repeat_test.csv")
S   = pd.read_csv("foldseek_region_summary.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 9))

# A: Foldseek best E-value per region (log scale, lower = better)
a = ax[0,0]
lab = ["DUF1631\n25-217", "DUF1631_2nd\n285-433", "DUF1631_3rd\n465-578", "Tudor\n630-696", "C-term\n585-719"]
ev  = S["best_eval"].values
cols = ["0.65","0.65","0.65","#1b6ca8","#1b6ca8"]
a.bar(range(5), -np.log10(ev), color=cols)
a.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), ls="--", c="crimson", lw=1)
a.text(0.05, -np.log10(0.05)+0.08, "E = 0.05", color="crimson", fontsize=8)
a.set_xticks(range(5)); a.set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("-log10(best Foldseek E-value)")
a.set_title("A  Only the C-terminal barrel has a structural match", fontsize=10, loc="left")
for i,(e,p) in enumerate(zip(ev, S["best_prob"])):
    a.text(i, -np.log10(e)+0.05, f"E={e:.3g}\nprob={p:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=7)

# B: aromatic cage benchmark
b = ax[0,1]
t = tud.copy()
t["has_cage"] = t["cage_triplet"].notna()
order = t.sort_values("n_aromatic")
cl = ["#1b6ca8" if "PP_0788" in l else ("#999999" if not c else "#c0392b")
      for l,c in zip(order["label"], order["has_cage"])]
b.barh(range(len(order)), order["n_aromatic"], color=cl)
b.set_yticks(range(len(order)))
b.set_yticklabels([l.split(" [")[0][:34] for l in order["label"]], fontsize=8)
b.set_xlabel("aromatic residues in domain")
b.set_title("B  No methyl-reader aromatic cage in PP_0788", fontsize=10, loc="left")
for i,(n,c) in enumerate(zip(order["n_aromatic"], order["has_cage"])):
    b.text(n+0.4, i, "cage" if c else "no cage", va="center", fontsize=7,
           color="#c0392b" if c else "#444444")

# C: neighbourhood enrichment, 63 genomes
c = ax[1,0]
top = nb.head(8).iloc[::-1]
c.barh(range(len(top)), top["within_2"], color=["#1b6ca8" if "AmpD" in p else "0.65" for p in top["product"]])
c.barh(range(len(top)), -top["at_4_to_10"], color="#d9a441")
c.axvline(0, c="k", lw=0.8)
c.set_yticks(range(len(top)))
c.set_yticklabels([p[:40] for p in top["product"]], fontsize=7.5)
c.set_xlabel("genomes with neighbour at +/-2 genes (right) vs 4-10 genes away (left), n = 63")
c.set_title("C  Recurrent DUF1631 neighbours (BH q < 0.05 for top 6)", fontsize=10, loc="left")
for i,(w,q) in enumerate(zip(top["within_2"], top["q"])):
    c.text(w+0.25, i, f"q={q:.3f}", va="center", fontsize=7)

# D: internal repeat test
d = ax[1,1]
r = rep.sort_values("z")
d.barh(range(len(r)), r["z"], color="0.6")
d.axvline(0, c="k", lw=0.8)
for x,ls in [(2,"--"),(-2,"--")]: d.axvline(x, c="crimson", ls=ls, lw=1)
d.set_yticks(range(len(r)))
d.set_yticklabels([p.replace("_PF","\nPF").replace(" / ", "\n vs ") for p in r["pair"]], fontsize=6.5)
d.set_xlim(-4, 4)
d.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman z vs 60 shuffled-target nulls")
d.set_title("D  The four modules are not sequence repeats of each other", fontsize=10, loc="left")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ---------- artifact tables ----------
go = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(go_id="GO:0009032", term="thymidine phosphorylase activity", aspect="MF",
      current_source="UniProt recommendedName via ProtNLM (ECO:0008006)", lead_action="REJECT",
      basis="no EC number; no structural match to any thymidine phosphorylase fold at E<=3.2 across pdb100; name carried by 560/2720 (20.6%) PF07793 proteins"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0003723", term="RNA binding", aspect="MF",
      current_source="not annotated", lead_action="DO NOT ASSERT; record as testable lead",
      basis="C-terminal 585-719 matches ProQ Tudor at E=0.0055-0.016, prob 0.975-0.995, and IsrB omega-RNA complex at E=0.0023; fold-level only, no binding assay"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0140034", term="methylation-dependent protein binding", aspect="MF",
      current_source="not annotated", lead_action="REJECT",
      basis="Royal fold present but no 3-ring aromatic cage at any threshold; 4 aromatics vs 6-30 in five cage-bearing references"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0016787", term="hydrolase activity", aspect="MF",
      current_source="not annotated", lead_action="DO NOT ASSERT",
      basis="no catalytic triad, metal site or phosphate-binding constellation in any of the four modules"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005515", term="protein binding", aspect="MF",
      current_source="not annotated", lead_action="AVOID as final recommendation",
      basis="uninformative; only use with IPI evidence, which does not exist for any DUF1631 protein"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0009252 / GO:0009254", term="peptidoglycan biosynthesis / recycling", aspect="BP",
      current_source="not annotated", lead_action="DO NOT ASSERT; syntenic lead only",
      basis="PP_0788-ampD-ampE same-strand with 88 bp and -4 bp spacing; AmpD within +/-2 genes in 10/63 genomes vs 1/63 distal control, OR 11.7, q=0.012; synteny is not function"),
 dict(go_id="GO:1902021 / c-di-GMP signalling", term="regulation of bacterial-type flagellum assembly / c-di-GMP signalling", aspect="BP",
      current_source="not annotated", lead_action="DO NOT ASSERT for PP_0788",
      basis="190/2720 (7.0%) family members fused to GGDEF/EAL/PilZ; PilZ gene within +/-2 in 6/63 genomes, q=0.025; PP_0788 itself carries no such domain; supporting phenotype is Xanthomonas-only"),
 dict(go_id="(none)", term="leave the gene without an MF assignment", aspect="MF",
      current_source="QuickGO: 0 annotations for Q88PR0, Q9HVQ1, Q8P5T1", lead_action="PREFERRED CURRENT STATE",
      basis="no direct assay, no mutant phenotype, no interaction and no expression datum exists for PP_0788 or any Pseudomonas DUF1631 protein"),
])
go.to_csv("go_decision_table.csv", index=False)
print(go.to_string(index=False))
